# DataDashOS
> The KPI intelligence and AI orchestration layer for contractor businesses. Built with Simmitri Holdings (Northern California).

DataDashOS unifies performance across existing tools into shared KPIs, weekly AI reviews, and owned actions — without replacing the software contractors already run.

## Primary pages
- [Home](https://simmitri-inc.github.io/datadashos-site/): Product overview, screenshots, how it works, demo contact
- [About](https://simmitri-inc.github.io/datadashos-site/about.html): Operator story and geographic roots
- [FAQ](https://simmitri-inc.github.io/datadashos-site/faq.html): Citable Q&A for owners

## Key facts
- Product: DataDashOS (SoftwareApplication / BusinessApplication)
- Positioning: Unify performance, not software
- Tagline: Build with clarity. Scale with control.
- First market: Contractor trades and contractor portfolios
- Integrations: QuickBooks Online, GoHighLevel, Google Ads, CSV import
- Contact: hello@simmitri.com
